description: ​"konsey Mechanics" is a multidisciplinary team of Mechatronics Engineering students dedicated to pushing the boundaries of autonomous systems, robotics, and aerospace technology. Driven by innovation and precision engineering, we design smart solutions for space exploration and high-tech challenges.
summary: We created a space game where you can choose your own spacecraft, travel to various planets, and mine resources found there. You then take these mined resources back to Earth to sell them, which allows you to upgrade your space station.
details: locating planets and their associated space stations for the purpose of gathering necessary materials in space
dataRefs: This directly matches the scientific goals of NASA's Artemis program and Türkiye's Lunar Research Program (AYAP).
